name: King's Qualities
description: The will of a king: the seed of Conqueror's Haki, about one in a few million.
hint: Some days a room goes quiet when you are angry, and you do not know why.

name: The Will of D.
description: An inherited will nobody can explain.
hint: Old people sometimes look at your name a second time.

name: The Voice of All Things
description: Hears the voices of everything that lives.
hint: On quiet nights you could swear the ship is talking.

name: Anomalous Body
description: A body unlike any other: it can hold two Devil Fruits.
hint: Doctors frown at your heartbeat and will not say why.

name: Demon Aura
description: A swordsman's will so hard others see a demon behind them.
hint: People who face you in a fight sometimes look past you, frightened.
